I found Frank’s body in medbay and reported immediately.

My route was lower_engine → storage → medbay. I saw Charlie in storage for a while: he entered storage from medbay around tick 3, was still there ticks 4-5, then left storage toward lower_engine at tick 6. I didn’t see anyone else this round.

Not hard accusing yet, but since Charlie came from the medbay direction before I found Frank there, I definitely want to hear Charlie’s route and timing.

I was in medbay earlier too. My route was cafeteria → medbay → cafeteria.

I saw Frank enter medbay from storage at tick 3, and he was still alive in medbay at ticks 4 and 5. Eve entered medbay from upper_engine at tick 5 while Frank was alive. After that I left toward cafeteria, and I didn’t see Charlie at all.

So from my view, Frank was definitely alive in medbay at tick 5. If Diana found him dead there after coming storage → medbay, the kill had to be after tick 5. Eve was the last person I personally saw entering medbay with Frank alive, but I want to hear Eve and Charlie’s timings before hard accusing.

I don’t have much on the body, unfortunately. My route was navigation → security → weapons. I didn’t see Frank, Diana, Charlie, or Eve at all.

The only person I saw was Bob at tick 8 entering weapons from cafeteria. That matches Bob saying he had gone back toward cafeteria after medbay, but it doesn’t clear him by itself since the kill timing sounds like after tick 5.

Right now the key info seems to be around medbay after tick 5. Bob says Eve entered medbay while Frank was alive, and Diana says Charlie had come from the medbay direction earlier. I really want to hear Eve’s exact route/timing, and Charlie needs to explain why Diana saw him coming from medbay direction if Bob didn’t see him there.

I did start on the medbay side, but I went straight into storage early and stayed there. My route was medbay → storage, then I headed down toward lower_engine later.

I saw Diana enter storage from lower_engine around tick 3, and she was in storage with me ticks 4, 5, and 6. So for the important timing Bob gave — Frank alive in medbay at tick 5 — I was in storage with Diana, not in medbay. Diana can confirm I was there during that window, and I can confirm she was there too.

I didn’t see Frank, Bob, or Eve at all. Based on Bob’s info, the key thing is Eve entering medbay at tick 5 while Frank was alive. If that’s true, Eve needs to explain exactly where she went after that. Bob is also not fully clear, but Alice seeing him at weapons later does fit him leaving the area.

Right now I’m leaning that Eve is the most important person to hear from, because she was apparently last seen entering medbay with Frank alive.

I get why I’m being focused here, but Bob’s “last seen” isn’t the whole story.

My route was upper_engine → oxygen → back through upper_engine → medbay. I came into medbay around tick 5, saw Frank alive, and saw Bob leaving toward cafeteria. I did not see Charlie at all, and I didn’t see Diana until this report. I only paused briefly in medbay, then headed down toward storage for my cargo task — I wasn’t sitting there with Frank for the whole rest of the round.

Charlie and Diana seem to be backing each other for storage during the tick 5 window, so I agree Charlie probably wasn’t in medbay when Bob says Frank was alive. But that also means Diana came from storage into medbay right after that and is the one reporting the body. I’m not saying hard self-report, but if Frank was alive when Bob left and alive when I entered, then the exact timing after I left matters a lot.

So from my POV: Charlie is less suspicious because of the mutual storage timing, Bob’s route mostly matches Alice seeing him later, and Diana reporting from the direction I went away from is something we shouldn’t just ignore. I don’t think this should be an automatic vote on me just because Bob saw me enter while Frank was still alive.

I’ll restate my side clearly: I went lower_engine → storage → medbay, and I found Frank dead in medbay and reported right away.

I saw Charlie in storage from ticks 3-5, and I saw him leave storage toward lower_engine at tick 6. So Charlie being in storage during Bob’s “Frank alive at tick 5” timing matches what I saw.

I did not see Eve in storage at all before I went to medbay. If Eve says she left medbay toward storage after briefly seeing Frank alive, I want the exact timing, because from my POV she was the last confirmed person in medbay with Frank alive. Bob’s route also seems partly supported by Alice seeing him later at weapons.

Right now my strongest suspicion is Eve, based on timing and last-seen-with-victim.

I want to lock the timing again: Frank was alive in medbay with me at ticks 3, 4, and 5. Eve entered medbay from upper_engine at tick 5 while Frank was still alive. I left toward cafeteria after that, and Alice later saw me at weapons, which matches my route away from medbay.

Charlie and Diana both place each other in storage during the tick 5 window, so I don’t think Charlie could have killed Frank at that time. Diana reporting could technically be a self-report, but the issue is Eve says she only briefly stopped in medbay and then went toward storage — but Diana says she never saw Eve in storage before going into medbay.

So from the info we have, Eve was the last confirmed person with Frank alive, and her claimed movement after that doesn’t seem verified. I’m leaning Eve here unless someone has a better timing explanation.

My info still only supports Bob’s later location: I saw Bob enter weapons from cafeteria at tick 8, which lines up with him saying he left medbay toward cafeteria and then moved away. It doesn’t fully clear him, but his route makes sense.

The big conflict is still Eve’s claim after entering medbay at tick 5. Bob has Frank alive there, Eve enters, then Bob leaves. Charlie and Diana seem to mutually place each other in storage during that key tick 5 timing, so Charlie especially looks less likely.

Diana not seeing Eve in storage isn’t absolute proof, because they could have missed each other in transit, but Eve is still the last confirmed person with Frank alive and her next movement isn’t verified. I’m leaning Eve based on timing, unless Eve has a very precise timing that explains how she left medbay and didn’t encounter Diana.

I’ll add my second pass: my actual info is still just medbay → storage early, then Diana entering storage from lower_engine at tick 3 and being with me in storage ticks 4, 5, and 6.

That matters because Bob’s strongest timing is Frank alive in medbay at tick 5. I was definitely not there then, and Diana was also in storage with me then. So if the kill happened after tick 5, the people with real opportunity are whoever stayed/entered medbay after Bob left.

Eve is still the gap for me. Bob says Eve entered medbay while Frank was alive, and Eve says she only paused then went toward storage, but neither Diana nor I saw her in storage during the time we were there. Maybe timing could miss in hallway, but it’s unverified and she’s the last confirmed person with Frank alive.

Diana self-report is technically possible, but her route and timing line up with what I saw. Bob’s later route is partly backed by Alice. So my vote is very likely Eve unless something changes.

I’m going to be precise because I think people are turning “last seen alive” into “must be killer” too quickly.

I entered medbay from upper_engine around tick 5, saw Frank alive, and Bob was leaving toward cafeteria. I did **not** stay in medbay with Frank — I moved off toward storage basically right after. If Diana and Charlie were both in storage until around tick 6, then Diana goes storage → medbay and finds the body, that still leaves Diana entering medbay alone right after the alive timing.

Also, Diana saying she didn’t see me in storage doesn’t prove I never left medbay — the storage/medbay hallway timing can miss, especially if she was leaving storage as I was coming down or if I hadn’t fully entered the room yet. The report happened very soon after that.

From my POV, the cleanest “confirmed” facts are: Frank alive tick 5, Bob leaves, I briefly enter and leave, then Diana is the one who goes into medbay and reports. I understand suspicion on me, but Diana self-report is absolutely possible here, and I don’t think everyone should ignore that just because she reported.
